design_basis: Roles are derived from reproduced or documented capability asymmetries. No structure is inherited from an earlier lane's proposal.

evidence_labels.DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED: a command was run or an artifact recomputed, here or in a cited lane receipt
evidence_labels.DOCUMENTED: an official source states it and the URL is recorded
evidence_labels.FOUNDER_SUPPLIED: stated by the founder and treated as established input; not reproduced by any lane

platforms.founder_characterisation: An agent platform, not one agent and not a narrow repository worker.

asymmetries.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED
asymmetries.claim: It writes the canonical store directly and provably. R1 GitHub immutable-SHA custody is the one route that survived independent challenge: a fresh clone fetched the evidence commit and independently matched all 13 listed entries.

asymmetries.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED
asymmetries.claim: It is already operating as a multi-agent platform: nine top-level cloud agents on this repository, four distinct exact model configurations and two model families, in one account. A fifth configuration, gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh, is documented below the top level as the L3 acceptor and is not counted in the reproduced figure.

asymmetries.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED
asymmetries.claim: A single run can hold isolated subagents, each in its own git worktree on its own branch and namespace. This lane is one of them.
asymmetries.evidence: GROUP-MANIFEST-OE-20260822-v001.json parents[] and this lane's own worktree

asymmetries.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED
asymmetries.claim: It has a full container runtime for hermetic replay with no network and no inherited credentials: Docker Engine 29.1.4, API 1.52, answering on 127.0.0.1:2375 without authentication. There is no docker CLI, which is why it was missed for so long.

asymmetries.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED
asymmetries.claim: Browser capability is present and the agent-facing tool is absent. Chrome 148 runs headless and returns a parsed DOM; DISPLAY :1 is live with Xtigervnc and a noVNC bridge; no browser, computer-control, web-search or web-fetch tool appears in any tool list or MCP catalogue.

asymmetries.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED
asymmetries.claim: Its own Agent API is live and credential-blocked rather than unsupported: /v1/agents, /v1/agents/{id}/runs, /v1/models, /v1/repositories and /v1/me all return 401, while nonexistent routes return a differently shaped 404.

asymmetries.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED
asymmetries.claim: Egress is unrestricted, so any HTTPS route the estate needs is reachable without an allowlist change.

asymmetries.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED
asymmetries.claim: GitHub Actions gives it a second execution domain on a different machine, which is a real independence gain for replay even though it is not independent corroboration when the producer wrote the assertions.

asymmetries.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED
asymmetries.claim: It holds no authenticated founder session and no microphone, and cannot acquire either. A cloud VM has no route to the founder's logged-in browser, and every mechanism for building one admits a third party into the trust boundary.

asymmetries.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED
asymmetries.claim: Its durable store is a per-run mailbox rather than cross-run continuity: /cursor/stores exposes only the run's own bcId and foreign store paths cannot be created.

asymmetries.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED
asymmetries.claim: Eight MCP namespaces are reachable from this runtime. Three are ready (cursor-cloud, cursor-subscriptions, Cloudflare-docs) and five report needsAuth (Supabase, Vercel, Cloudflare-bindings, Cloudflare-builds, Cloudflare-observability). The unauthenticated five are the estate's nearest unclaimed authorised access.

asymmetries.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED
asymmetries.claim: CURSOR_API_KEY is absent from this runtime by name census, and the injected secret set contains only four unrelated AUREA_E2E_* names. The key the founder says exists is not reachable from here today.

platforms.kind: agent platform with authenticated estate access
platforms.founder_characterisation: A platform that can be launched at scale across multiple projects, models, teams and functions. It must not be reduced to evidence review or a passive founder interface.

asymmetries.label: FOUNDER_SUPPLIED
asymmetries.claim: It is the only surface holding the founder's authenticated account context: 11 projects, 61 chats in OBZIO — STRATEGIC CONTROL, 121 ordinary sidebar chats, project instructions, project Sources and provider memory. No Cursor agent can reach any of it.
asymmetries.evidence: founder review; not reproduced by any lane

asymmetries.label: DOCUMENTED
asymmetries.claim: Connectors, plugins and MCP servers run inside the chat and bring context and actions from other services into it. This is the estate's only route into Ahmed/Obzio systems that the repository does not already reach.

asymmetries.label: DOCUMENTED
asymmetries.claim: It has a durable cadence engine: Scheduled tasks, standalone or in-chat, with RFC 5545 RRULE recurrence, able to invoke skills and plugins. Cursor's nearest equivalent is a per-run subscription that expires with the run.

asymmetries.label: DOCUMENTED
asymmetries.claim: It packages reusable capability as skills with progressive disclosure, and runs subagents inside a chat that return summaries rather than raw intermediate output.

asymmetries.label: FOUNDER_SUPPLIED
asymmetries.claim: It is the platform the founder actually speaks to, which is the only place a voice-first intake with same-exchange read-back can happen at all.

asymmetries.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED
asymmetries.claim: Its API is a different store from its UI. The Responses and Conversations routes operate on api.openai.com platform objects and cannot see the projects, the chats, project instructions, Sources, memory or the Scheduled view. No amount of API activation changes that.

asymmetries.label: DOCUMENTED
asymmetries.claim: Workspace Agents can start work inside the account from outside and report status, and the documentation states plainly that the agent's response cannot currently be retrieved through the API. It is dispatch without return.

asymmetries.label: DOCUMENTED
asymmetries.claim: Conversations are retained until explicitly deleted, are not Zero-Data-Retention eligible, and deleting a conversation does not delete its items. Their metadata is capped at 16 pairs with 64-character keys and 512-character values, which is far below what provenance requires.

asymmetries.label: DOCUMENTED
asymmetries.claim: Structured Outputs with strict JSON Schema makes an illegal state ungeneratable rather than merely discouraged, and works inside Batch as well as Responses.

asymmetries.label: DOCUMENTED
asymmetries.claim: Batch runs high-volume low-reasoning work at 50% cost on a separate rate-limit pool, up to 50,000 requests and 200 MB per batch, with a 24-hour turnaround.

platforms.founder_characterisation: Capable but paused. Do not message, operate, configure it, or make it central. Its future role may be planned.

asymmetries.label: FOUNDER_SUPPLIED
asymmetries.claim: It is a repository-connected discovery and synthesis factory intended to run at office scale, on the order of one hundred coworkers and agents when provider capacity allows.
asymmetries.evidence: FOUNDER-OPERATING-DIRECTIVES-20260822.md, capability factory and compounding loop

asymmetries.label: DOCUMENTED
asymmetries.claim: It is paused before its first message because the available operation was not yet strategically controlled. The pause is a reversible routing decision, not a rejection of the platform.

asymmetries.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED
asymmetries.claim: Its provider surface is recorded with a stable ID (space 1054976614269477) and a rename requirement, and no return branch exists. The estate can address it when reactivated without inventing a locator.

platforms.founder_characterisation: Git and other open, portable Obzio-controlled state remain canonical.

asymmetries.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED
asymmetries.claim: It is the canonical store and the only custody route that survived independent challenge.

asymmetries.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED
asymmetries.claim: Actions is a substitute runtime that executes the estate's bytes on a machine no agent controls.

asymmetries.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED
asymmetries.claim: Issues, Actions secrets, branch protection, webhooks, deployments, code scanning and Dependabot all return 403 to the agent's installation token. Issues are therefore unavailable as a coordination substrate, and no agent can read or set branch protection, so the protected-branch rule has no server-side enforcement.

asymmetries.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED
asymmetries.claim: It is a single vendor holding the hosting, the API and the permissions at once. Everything currently depends on it, which is a strength and a concentration in the same fact.

asymmetries.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED
asymmetries.claim: The last thing to reach main was PR #3 on 2026-08-19, and seven open PRs sit in a four-deep stack where three branches are simultaneously the head of one PR and the base of another. Nothing in the chain can land until the bottom lands.

platforms.founder_characterisation: A prior directive names Qwen as the coordinating open-weight base with Kimi and DeepSeek alongside and Grok on Cursor. That allocation is neither deleted nor newly bound.

asymmetries.claim: Open weights and local operation are different properties and they come apart at the top. Kimi K3 is about 2.78 trillion parameters and ungated, and no laptop will run it; Qwen3.8-27B is 27.8B under Apache-2.0 with a published 4-bit mlx build, gpt-oss-20b is 21.5B under Apache-2.0, GLM-4.7-Flash is 31.2B under MIT.

asymmetries.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED
asymmetries.claim: Routing policy dominates spend more than model choice: about 50x on input and 88x on output between the cheapest capable open route and the frontier open route.

asymmetries.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED

asymmetries.label: DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED

decision_classes.title: What the programme is and how it is divided
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Reserved. A whole-operation commission is precisely a commission that claims programme shape, so reserving the class makes one rejectable at admission rather than discoverable later by contradiction.

decision_classes.title: Binding company strategy
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Operating method is delegable and company strategy is not. Functions emit proposals; only a founder binding produces a decision.

decision_classes.title: Committing money or a recurring obligation
decision_classes.why_this_holder: On the founder's own stop list. Functions compare, cost and recommend.

decision_classes.title: Owner identity acts and secret material
decision_classes.why_this_holder: On the founder's own stop list. No function requests a secret in chat or stores a value.

decision_classes.title: Contacting anyone outside Obzio
decision_classes.why_this_holder: On the founder's own stop list, and prohibited to every function.

decision_classes.title: Reactivating SW
decision_classes.why_this_holder: SW is paused by founder decision and stays unmessaged, unoperated and unconfigured until a separate founder reactivation.

decision_classes.title: Granting new external OAuth or account permissions
decision_classes.why_this_holder: On the founder's own stop list. This is the class the Supabase MCP authorisation falls into, which is why it returns as an owner action rather than being performed.

decision_classes.title: Declaring which competing currentness claim wins
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Four scopes have competing claims and the compiler refuses all four. Choosing is an authority act, not a compilation result.

decision_classes.title: Binding a named model family
decision_classes.why_this_holder: The earlier Qwen/Kimi/DeepSeek/Grok allocation is explicitly neither deleted nor renewed. Recommendation is delegable; binding is not.

decision_classes.title: Role-specific disclosure and codename policy
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Deferred by the founder. Registered with an owner and an activation trigger, building nothing, so the gap cannot be filled by accident.

decision_classes.title: Who may decide what
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Held where the partition is machine-checkable, which is the repository. Seven undifferentiated commission overlaps and one identifier collision exist today because nothing owns it.

decision_classes.title: What is current
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Held by the compiler that can refuse. Four scopes currently have competing claims and the resolver withholds an answer rather than picking a majority.

decision_classes.title: What replaces what
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Separated from currentness so that no single function can retire an inconvenient instruction by declaring it superseded and then declaring itself current.

decision_classes.title: What evidence advances a claim
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Held in the repository because the ladder must be applicable by someone who was not there. Eight of sixteen workstreams currently claim more than their evidence supports.

decision_classes.title: Custody of unresolved questions
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Open questions currently live in the closing paragraphs of returns and evaporate when a chat scrolls.

decision_classes.title: Whether a design sends a routine verb to the founder
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Re-specified from the withdrawn touch-point budget: it detects and refuses routine relay, retrieval, comparison, merging and monitoring, and holds no cap on genuine decisions.

decision_classes.title: Whether a wave changed a live mechanism
decision_classes.why_this_holder: The directive requires every wave to end in a changed live mechanism. Unmeasured, a wave closes on documents.

decision_classes.title: What accounts, integrations, plugins, connectors and tools exist
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Only ChatGPT can see the founder's authenticated account surface. No Cursor agent can enumerate it, and the repository can prove it never held the enumeration.

decision_classes.title: Aligning existing capabilities so Cursor receives maximum useful authorised access
decision_classes.why_this_holder: The founder's named immediate role for ChatGPT. It is the only function whose output is other functions' authority to act.

decision_classes.title: Typing a live founder statement and reading it back inside the same exchange
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Capture must happen where the founder speaks, in the modality he uses, with a read-back before the exchange ends. A cloud agent is asynchronous and has no microphone.

decision_classes.title: Recovering and reconciling the corpus of standing founder intent
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Separated from capture: capture runs against the clock and its decisive act is refusal to type; corpus recovery can take its time and its decisive act is reconstruction.

decision_classes.title: What happens to the back catalogue of chats and projects
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Requires reading UI-resident content, which only the account owner's surface or an owner export can supply.

decision_classes.title: What cannot currently be assessed, and when that becomes a risk finding
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Unowned blind spots decay into assumed-clean. Dated ones decay into escalation.

decision_classes.title: The founder operating environment's architecture
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Founder-assigned to Cursor under COM-CUR-ENV-01 and retained at exactly that width.

decision_classes.title: The staged human implementation programme
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Founder-assigned to Cursor under the same commission.

decision_classes.title: Building, extracting and packaging portable capability
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Held where mechanisms are executable and testable. SW becomes a second holder under a separate lease when reactivated, never a sole one.

decision_classes.title: What the outside world offers that the estate is not using
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Deliberately overlapping in topic with several functions and disjoint in decision: it decides what enters the candidate register, not what is adopted.

decision_classes.title: Fixing a reproduced defect
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Held outside assurance so remediation cannot grade its own repair.

decision_classes.title: What the measure is
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Separated from acceptance so the measure cannot be moved to fit the artifact in front of it.

decision_classes.title: Whether a specific artifact is accepted
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Held in Cursor because independence here is produced by isolated context, distinct model identity and evidence custody, all of which Cursor supplies today and demonstrated by refusing.

decision_classes.title: What breaks
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Housed apart from acceptance because the adversarial relationship that produces the finding disappears when the attacker and the gate share history and incentive.

decision_classes.title: Whether a provider's claim of completion corresponds to anything
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Provider completion is required to be an observation. Something has to perform the corroboration that turns it into a fact or a contradiction.

decision_classes.title: Whether a route works end to end
decision_classes.why_this_holder: One route has already been lost to quota exhaustion with no qualified successor.

decision_classes.title: Whether to keep running and when to stop
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Distinct from spend, which asks what things cost. Re-specified so that structurally unmeasurable headroom is recorded as a blind spot rather than treated as zero.

decision_classes.title: Whether the estate could survive losing a provider
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Portability is a standing requirement that nothing currently tests, so lock-in accumulates invisibly until a route dies.

decision_classes.title: Where results are durably held and how they are addressed
decision_classes.why_this_holder: Held next to the canonical store. GitHub concentration is a live risk this function owns rather than one nobody owns.

acceptance_constitution.conclusion: Independent acceptance lives in Cursor and is multi-lane by default rather than multi-provider.

residual_class_that_does_need_a_second_p.class: claims about the Cursor platform's own behaviour
residual_class_that_does_need_a_second_p.why: A defect in the runtime is correlated across every lane inside it. The shared-worktree collision and the exit-zero push are exactly this class: no number of Cursor lanes would have been independent of them.
residual_class_that_does_need_a_second_p.cheapest_second_domain: GitHub Actions for execution (already reproduced), and a hosted open-weight route behind the adapter boundary for cognition
residual_class_that_does_need_a_second_p.explicitly_not: ChatGPT. Its asymmetry is access, not isolation, and routing evidence through the founder's authenticated account adds founder-visible context to the acceptance loop, which reduces independence rather than increasing it.

comparison_rule.problem: Several acceptance lanes may run, and comparing their verdicts is itself a merge act the founder must never perform.
comparison_rule.rule: Verdicts are tallied by a rule declared before the lanes run, never merged. Any REFUSE stands. Concordance is reported with its denominator. A lane that abstains is reported as an abstention, not dropped.
comparison_rule.why: This removes the arbitration step entirely rather than delegating it, which is what keeps a multi-lane design from recreating a comparison layer.

visibility_mechanism.name: Authority envelope plus contribution ledger
visibility_mechanism.requirement: Functions may overlap and collaborate, provided authority, provenance, conflicts and acceptance stay visible.
visibility_mechanism.why_it_is_estate_wide: The earlier design made overlap visible inside ChatGPT and listed everything else as held elsewhere. Cross-platform overlap was therefore not representable and could not be checked. Here every decision class in the estate has exactly one holder and every holder names its platform, so an overlap between a ChatGPT function and a Cursor function is an ordinary row rather than an invisible collision.

components.name: Authority envelope
components.content: One function, one appointment, one authority statement, one runtime binding, one return and evaluation route. These are exactly the five fields AGENTS.md rule 8 already requires, so the mechanism satisfies the repository's own rule rather than running beside it.

components.name: Runtime is not authority
components.content: A runtime binding records where a function executes. It never grants standing, and a rename never removes standing. A function whose only recorded authority is its runtime is rejected.

components.name: Decision-class partition with reserved classes
components.content: Every class has exactly one holder; ten classes are reserved to the founder and unclaimable; a function with an empty decides set is decorative and fails admission.

components.name: Contribution ledger
components.content: A non-holder touching a held class files a row: decision class, holder, contributor, wave, evidence label, position of agree, dissent or abstain, disposition and conflict id. Collaboration becomes a record instead of an inference, and an overruled dissent stays in the ledger.

components.name: Conflict as a first-class object
components.content: States OPEN, RESOLVED_BY_EVIDENCE, RESOLVED_BY_FOUNDER and STANDING_DISSENT. A conflict may not be closed by the holder alone when the contributor's position is DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED and the holder's is HYPOTHESIS: evidence outranks ownership. An unresolved conflict never blocks work; it is attached to the work as a standing dissent.

components.name: Acceptance independence
components.content: No function is its own acceptance owner, no producing function sits inside an assurance container, and the acceptance holder's own acceptance owner is the adversary.

components.name: Substitution route required
components.content: Every function names how its work would be performed if its platform were removed. This is the concrete form of the never-create-exclusive-dependency rule: without it, dependency accumulates silently until a route dies.

components.name: Projection into the runtime surface
components.content: The envelope is rendered into the surface where the work happens, carrying the short SHA of the register commit that generated it. In ChatGPT that is the first block of the project instructions and the first message of every chat; in Cursor it is the lane brief and the rules file; in CI it is a failing check. A surface whose header SHA does not match the current register is STALE_BINDING and cannot produce an admissible return until re-bound.
components.enforced_by: rolectl.py, invariant I14, plus the currentness check
components.why: This is what stops a project instruction block or a lane brief from becoming a second source of authority, which is the same failure as provider memory becoming canonical, in a different place.

founder_judgment_required.question: May a ChatGPT connector hold repository write?
founder_judgment_required.why_it_is_genuinely_founder_bound: It is a disclosure decision as much as a technical one, and it grants an external surface standing authority over the canonical store.
founder_judgment_required.what_it_unblocks: The only ongoing non-founder return route for every UI-resident function. Without it, ChatGPT's discovery, alignment, intake and salvage functions all return R0-DEGRADED.
founder_judgment_required.cheaper_variant_to_check_first: If a GitHub connector is already available on the account's plan, the return route collapses into R1 and no custom connector is needed. F-ESTATE settles this without a founder turn.

founder_judgment_required.question: Authorise the existing Supabase integration so the Cursor API key already held in Edge Secrets becomes reachable.
founder_judgment_required.why_it_is_genuinely_founder_bound: Granting a new external OAuth or account permission is on the founder's own stop list.
founder_judgment_required.what_it_unblocks: Programmatic creation and steering of Cursor runs, which is the strongest single lever against the founder acting as relay for multi-lane dispatch.
founder_judgment_required.cheaper_variant_to_check_first: None. The name census confirms the key is not injected into this runtime and the namespace confirms the route is unauthenticated.

founder_judgment_required.question: Is indefinite provider-side retention of founder-intent material acceptable?
founder_judgment_required.why_it_is_genuinely_founder_bound: Conversations are retained until deleted, are not ZDR-eligible, and deleting a conversation does not delete its items. Durability and retention are the same property seen from two sides and no setting separates them.
founder_judgment_required.what_it_unblocks: How much of the intent corpus may ever transit the Conversations endpoint. The repository stays canonical either way.
founder_judgment_required.cheaper_variant_to_check_first: Intent capture can run without Conversations at all, using the chat surface for capture and the repository for the record. The question only becomes live if API-side threading is wanted.

founder_judgment_required.question: Which competing pointer claim wins, PR #6 or PR #7?
founder_judgment_required.why_it_is_genuinely_founder_bound: Both rewrite the same pointer files with different bytes, so whichever merges first silently sets currentness for the other. The compiler refuses and records the refusal.
founder_judgment_required.what_it_unblocks: Four unresolvable currentness scopes, and the prohibition on writing state/**, operations/**, dispatch/** and modules/work_unit_contract/** from this lineage.
founder_judgment_required.cheaper_variant_to_check_first: None. This is an authority act by construction.

founder_judgment_required.question: Does the Qwen / Kimi / DeepSeek / Grok allocation still bind, and is the requirement open weights or runnable by us?
founder_judgment_required.why_it_is_genuinely_founder_bound: The directive explicitly neither deletes nor renews it, and the two readings select different families.
founder_judgment_required.what_it_unblocks: Model qualification, which currently cannot proceed without either reopening a settled decision or ignoring one.
founder_judgment_required.cheaper_variant_to_check_first: If the answer is runnable by us, the existing directive already holds and needs only to be reaffirmed with that reason attached; on the evidence Qwen is the only named family spanning both the API rung and the local rung under a permissive licence.

founder_judgment_required.question: Is GitHub acceptable as the sole host of canonical state, or should a second remote exist?
founder_judgment_required.why_it_is_genuinely_founder_bound: It is a resilience posture with a cost, not a technical finding.
founder_judgment_required.what_it_unblocks: The concentration risk F-CUSTODY owns. A second remote is cheap; the decision is whether the estate wants one.
founder_judgment_required.cheaper_variant_to_check_first: A signed git bundle committed on a cadence gives most of the recovery value with no second account, and can be built without a founder turn.

counting_rule: The only throughput number is ACCEPTED, issued by the holder of DC-ACCEPTANCE. Every other number is inventory and is reported with its accepted denominator.
